name: Plugsera Bulkrify – Bulk Editor for WooCommerce
author: plugsera

sections.description:
Bulk editing WooCommerce products is one of the most sensitive tasks for any store.

On large catalogs, bulk edits can:
• Change thousands of products by mistake
• Cause admin slowdowns or timeouts
• Break variable product pricing
• Leave no easy way to recover changes

Most bulk editors focus only on speed.

Bulkrify is built differently.

Bulkrify is a modern WooCommerce bulk editor plugin engineered with safety-first architecture, batch processing, and rollback support — so you can bulk edit products without fear of mistakes or site instability.

Everything runs inside your WordPress admin panel.
Your data stays on your server — not on ours.

🔹 What Bulkrify Free Does

Bulkrify Free gives you clean, reliable bulk editing without complexity.

You can:

  • Bulk edit product prices
  • Bulk edit stock quantity and stock status
  • Bulk edit SKU
  • Bulk edit product titles
  • Select and update multiple products at once
  • Work inside a modern, easy-to-use interface
  • Edit products directly in WooCommerce (no CSV import/export)
  • Keep all product data on your own server

This version is ideal for day-to-day bulk updates.

🔥 Bulkrify Pro – Built for Safety, Scale, and Control

Bulkrify Pro is designed for stores where bulk edit mistakes are expensive and performance matters.

Bulkrify Pro Features:

  • Spreadsheet-style (Excel-like) editor for WooCommerce products
  • Fast keyboard-based editing for professional workflows
  • Batch-based processing for large bulk edits
  • Helps reduce server load and admin timeouts
  • Reliable rollback for bulk and spreadsheet edits
  • Rollback support for:
    • Simple products
    • Variable products
    • Individual variations
  • One-click rollback of previous bulk operations
  • Safer editing for complex variable product structures
  • Designed to prevent costly bulk-edit mistakes
  • Optimized for large WooCommerce product catalogs
  • No CSV files required
  • No external APIs or third-party services

📌 Note:
Rollback and spreadsheet features are available only in the Pro plugin.
The free version does not include rollback functionality.

⭐ Why Choose Bulkrify Over Other Bulk Editors?

Many bulk editors focus on how fast you can edit.
Bulkrify focuses on what happens if something goes wrong.

  • Built with safety-first architecture
  • Batch processing reduces the risk of site slowdowns and crashes
  • Reliable rollback support — including variable products and variations
  • No CSV imports that can corrupt product data
  • No cloud-based processing or external APIs
  • No background syncing or hidden data transfers
  • Works entirely inside your WordPress admin panel
  • Designed for real-world WooCommerce stores with large catalogs

Bulkrify is built for users who want speed without sacrificing safety.

🔒 Your Data, Your Control

Bulkrify does not use external APIs or cloud servers.

  • No data sent outside your website
  • No third-party processing
  • No external tracking
  • No remote storage

All bulk editing happens locally inside your WordPress installation.

👥 Who Is Bulkrify For?

Bulkrify is ideal for:

  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Store managers handling large product catalogs
  • Agencies managing client stores
  • Anyone who wants safer, more controlled bulk product editing

Learn more about Bulkrify and advanced features on the official website:
https://bulkrify.pages.dev
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/plugsera-bulkrify-bulk-editor/, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Bulkrify to start bulk editing products.
sections.faq:
Does the free version include rollback?

No. Rollback is available only in Bulkrify Pro.

Does rollback work for variable products and variations?

Yes. Bulkrify Pro supports rollback for simple products, variable products, and their variations.

Is Bulkrify safe for large WooCommerce stores?

Yes. Bulkrify Pro uses batch-based processing to handle large bulk edits more safely and reduce server load.

Does Bulkrify use external APIs or servers?

No. Bulkrify runs entirely inside your WordPress installation.

Is my product data shared with anyone?

No. Your data stays on your own server.
